description: Estimates Phi+ lab-frame fidelity, the fully entangled fraction over local unitary frames, and their fidelity gap from a physical two-qubit density matrix without acquiring data or changing hardware.
summary: Estimate lab-frame fidelity and fully entangled fraction from a density matrix.

twoQubitDensityMatrix.description: Output object from ReconstructTwoQubitDensityMatrix, containing its physical rho payload in |00>, |01>, |10>, |11> order. rho requires numeric 4x4 real arrays; omitted imag means zero, while a supplied imag array must have the same shape. Physical state validation reuses the shared density-matrix validator.

numericLocalUnitaryRestarts.description: Number of random numerical local-unitary initializations in addition to the identity initialization.

numericLocalUnitarySeed.description: Optional deterministic seed for the numerical local-unitary diagnostic.

entanglement.fidelity.estimate.entangled.description: Dimensionless state metrics in [0,1]: labFrameFidelity is the Phi+ overlap in the current laboratory frame; fullyEntangledFraction is the SVD maximum overlap over all maximally entangled two-qubit states, invariant under local unitaries; frameMisalignmentFidelityLoss is their gap (clamped at zero for roundoff), ideally recoverable by local compensation. targetStateDefinition fixes Phi+ = (HH + VV) / sqrt(2). crossCheck contains the independent numerical estimate, bestAttempt/attemptCount, best-frame unitaryA/unitaryB/rhoOptimized as real/imag payloads, numeric SO(3) rotations/unitarity residuals/determinants, and rotationComparison with laboratory/direct/relative angles, Procrustes maps, aligned correlation matrices and Frobenius distances. Numeric and SVD frames share the dagger state convention and T'=RA T RB^T. Rotations can differ at equal optima; even relative maps can differ at degenerate optima. There is no fidelity delta, agreement tolerance/verdict or comparison gate, and no full restart history. svdLocalUnitary retains correlation/singular-value diagnostics. No metric implies an applied hardware correction or identifies the cause of a fidelity deficit.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.entangled.description: Path to the detailed JSON fidelity report.
Path to the compact Markdown fidelity summary.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.densityMa.description: Matching PNG/SVG pairs in labFrame and svdFrame, each with real and imaginary 4x4 density-matrix panels, a common signed color scale, and its Phi+ metric in the title. The SVD frame is a theoretical local-unitary transformation, not a hardware correction.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.fidelityC.description: Matching PNG/SVG bar chart of laboratory-frame Phi+ fidelity and the independent numerical local-unitary cross-check, on a dimensionless [0,1] axis; no hardware correction is applied.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.svdDiagno.description: Matching PNG/SVG diagnostic panels of the signed X/Y/Z Pauli correlation matrix, lab/SVD/numerical fidelities on [0,1] axes and singular values; no fidelity delta, agreement verdict or hardware correction.

entanglement.fidelity.artifact.localUnit.description: Matching PNG/SVG panels of numerical/SVD SO(3) rotations for both arms on a common signed [-1,1] scale, direct/relative angles in degrees, matrix distances and numerical residuals. Gauge freedom and degenerate optima prevent interpreting rotation differences as an acceptance gate.
